notes:
Account overview: SurgeVector is a mid-stage fintech that provides real-time pricing and trade routing for retail brokerage partners. High sensitivity to both latency and per-request cost. Primary ask: move from OpenAI-hosted prototypes to predictable, cheaper inference with p95 latency <= 60ms for chat-driven trade recommendations and reranking path selection. Interested in Redwood Dedicated but need clear quantization/accuracy tradeoffs and fallback routing to hosted models during maintenance.

Key constraints / asks (shorthand):
- p95 <= 60ms for single-turn chat (context ~512 tokens)
- sustained throughput: 600 reqs/sec for reranking (short sequences 64 tokens)
- cost target: < $0.80 per 1k inference-equivalent queries (goal to halve current infra cost)
- cannot send raw customer PII outside VPC; must support KMS + SSO + detailed audit logs
- retention policy: transaction traces stored 180 days, outputs masked in logs

Meetings & timeline (bullet fragments):
- 2025-01-22 discovery call (Jordan/Maya) — fireflies ff_2025-01-22_8473. Client demoed current inference flow; noted jitter spikes during market open.
- 2025-01-29 internal feasibility: ops asked for quantized 8-bit runbook; team flagged accuracy delta concerns on tail-case scoring.
- 2025-02-10 security kickoff — requested DPA + ISO attestation; submitted SEC-1187 ticket for encryption questions.
- 2025-02-19 design review (Maya, Rajiv) — agreed on 2-day POC window in April, scope: dedicated 1xA10G node, perf bench + regression evals. fireflies ff_2025-02-19_9210.
- 2025-02-25 pricing/contract sync — finance asked for committed throughput pricing vs burst; client prefers monthly committed with burst buffer.

Technical notes (copied from SE calls):
- Prefer Llama-derivative 70B quantized FP8/INT8 candidate for reranking; want side-by-side compare with smaller 13B quantized for latency.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions: batching windows, KV cache TTL for session affinity, and automatic prefix caching to reduce token compute.
- Will run perf bench harness: synthetic traffic (Poisson arrivals, 600rps reranking) + production trace replay for chat. Request Redwood to provide benchmark parameters and helper script.
- Concern: continuous batching can increase latency variance during market open bursts; requested policy to cap batching to meet SLOs and fallback to smaller model shards.

POC success criteria (client-stated):
- Demonstrate stable p95 <= 60ms at 80% of expected traffic on Dedicated node.
- Quantized model accuracy within 2% of FP16 baseline for reranking NDCG.
- Clear cost projection showing >= 40% savings vs current managed API spend at scale.

Next steps (short notes):

- Jordan to coordinate legal DPA responses (Drive: price-deck-surgevector.pdf).
- Schedule 2-day POC: proposed window 2025-04-07 to 2025-04-08.
